headline: Lost Cat Found After Six Years Miles From Home
meta_description: Pandora the cat has been reunited with her owners in Aberdeenshire six years after escaping when a road accident ejected her basket.
summary_short: A cat named Pandora has been reunited with her owners in Aberdeenshire after six years apart, following a road accident that forced her to escape miles from home.
body:
Pandora the cat has been reunited with her owners in Aberdeenshire after six years apart. The remarkable reunion came about a month ago when a kind-hearted woman contacted the Cats Protection organization with information about the lost pet.

The journey back began years earlier when a road accident caused Pandora's basket to be ejected from a vehicle, sending the cat fleeing miles away from her home. For six years, her family had no trace of her whereabouts. The combination of the woman's compassion in reaching out and the Cats Protection's network made the long-awaited reunion possible.

The story stands as a reminder of how lost pets can sometimes find their way back, and how community members and animal welfare organizations working together can restore families that thought they'd lost their companions forever.
quick_facts: Pandora missing for six years after road accident
Cat ejected miles from home in Aberdeenshire
Reunited through kind woman and Cats Protection
